# Public-health evidence dossier

## Scope

Disease/event, jurisdiction, population, case definition, and data cutoff.

## Transmission evidence

Separate established routes, plausible routes, unknowns, and source dates. Do not infer an individual's infection or contagiousness.

## Surveillance metrics

| Metric | Numerator | Denominator | Period | Case status | Uncertainty | Source |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|

## Interpretation boundaries

Distinguish surveillance, modeled estimate, association, and causal evidence. State delays and revisions. No diagnosis, treatment, or forecast without a separately validated clinical/epidemiological method.
